name: 定常 Kovasznay 流收敛阶验证
ref_source: Kovasznay 1948 Proc. Camb. Phil. Soc. 44:58 精确解（网格收敛阶验证） DOI:10.1017/s0305004100023999
tol_policy: L2 收敛阶 >=1.8 (名义二阶) | 指标: log-log 斜率 on 32/64/128 三套网格
citation: Kovasznay, L. I. G. (1948). Laminar flow behind a two-dimensional grid. Proc. Cambridge Philos. Soc. 44(1), 58-62.

name: 三维制造解（manufactured solution）NS 验证
ref_source: Ethier & Steinman 1994 Int. J. Numer. Methods Fluids 19:369 精确解 DOI:10.1002/fld.1650190502
tol_policy: <1% | 指标: 速度 L_inf 相对误差 vs 精确解 (Re=1 与 Re=100 两工况)
citation: Ethier, C. R., & Steinman, D. A. (1994). Exact fully 3D Navier-Stokes solutions for benchmarking. Int. J. Numer. Methods Fluids 19(5), 369-375.

name: 周期山丘流分离与再附长度
ref_source: Breuer et al. 2009 Computers & Fluids 38:433 周期山丘基准（ERCOFTAC 81） DOI:10.1016/j.compfluid.2008.05.002
tol_policy: <10% | 指标: 再附长度 x_r/H 与 y/H=0.5 处平均速度剖面 vs Breuer2009 (Re=2800)
citation: Breuer, M., Peller, N., Rapp, C., & Manhart, M. (2009). Flow over periodic hills - numerical and experimental study in a wide range of Reynolds numbers. Computers & Fluids 38(2), 433-457.

name: 平板层流边界层摩阻系数
ref_source: Blasius 1908 / Schlichting 1979 §7 相似解表 c_f=0.664/sqrt(Re_x) DOI(次级):10.1002/zamm.19800600419
tol_policy: <3% | 指标: 局部摩阻 c_f 与形状因子 H vs Blasius 相似解 (Re_x=1e5)
citation: Schlichting, H. (1979). Boundary-Layer Theory, 7th ed., McGraw-Hill, Section 7 (Blasius similarity solution, c_f = 0.664/sqrt(Re_x)).
ref_verify_note: Schlichting 1979 专著；Crossref 有 ZAMM 1980 书评记录佐证

name: 湍流槽道 Re_tau=180 平均速度对数律

citation: Kim, J., Moin, P., & Moser, R. (1987). Turbulence statistics in fully developed channel flow at low Reynolds number. J. Fluid Mech. 177, 133-166.

name: 浅水溃坝 Ritter/Stoker 精确解

citation: Ritter, A. (1892). Die Fortpflanzung der Wasserwellen. Z. Ver. Deutsch. Ing. 36(33), 947-954; Stoker, J. J. (1957). Water Waves. Interscience. 现代检索版: Delestre, O. et al. (2013). SWASHES: a compilation of shallow water analytic solutions for hydraulic and hydrologic studies. Int. J. Numer. Methods Fluids 72(3), 269-300.

secondary_citation: Delestre, O. et al. (2013). SWASHES: a compilation of shallow water analytic solutions for hydraulic and hydrologic studies. Int. J. Numer. Methods Fluids 72(3), 269-300.

name: NACA0012 无粘绕流升力斜率
